nodes.statement: check_missed_vertex = true
nodes.definitions:
def missedVertex (i b : Fin 5) : Fin 5 → Bool := fun j => if j = i then b = 0 else true

def inFourSubcube (i b : Fin 5) (v : Fin 5 → Bool) : Bool := v i = b

def constSupport (v : Fin 5 → Bool) : Bool := true

def check_missed_vertex : Bool :=
  ∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ b : Bool, constSupport (missedVertex i b) = true ∧ ¬ inFourSubcube i b (missedVertex i b)
